mu_name_from: MuMain loads MODEL_BLACK_DRAGON_ARMOR from Data/Player/ArmorMale17.bmd (ZzzOpenData.cpp:159-163: AccessModel(..., "ArmorMale", 17); the set at index 16 is file 17). MU's group 8 number 16.
why_this_one: The knight's Tarkan set (KR 0.84 patch note, docs/tarkan-port.md), which WebZen's item(Kor).txt flags as a monster drop at levels Tarkan's and Blood Castle 6's monsters reach; it was not built (the user, 2026-10-06: 'lets skip Storm Crow set, but make all others').

stats.note: The item's own row: OpenMU's Season 6 initialiser (0.95d's Armors.cs stops at index 14, before Black Dragon); WebZen's 1.00m item(Kor).txt carries the set.
stats.classes_from: darkKnightClassLevel 1 and every other class 0 in Season 6, the Magic Gladiator too: a first-class knight's set.

sheet_from: MuMain/src/bin/Data/Player, decoded with pipeline/decode_texture.py: near-black lacquered plate with gold trim; hide is MU's black cap over the openings. lower_bd_t is the .OZT lower_bd, its alpha cutting a third away, on the cuirass's skirt; the pants wear the .OZJ.
material_note: painted_steel, as Dark Phoenix: Black Dragon is black lacquer with gold trim painted on, and plate_steel reads such paint as polished black metal with white blowouts in the fire (studio, 2026-10-04, on Dark Phoenix). MU's paint is the look.
material_overrides_note: painted_steel's own grain is a blade's, brushed along V; on plate it drew vertical streaks down the legs and the pauldrons (studio, 2026-10-04: the user, 'something wrong with pants'). plate_steel's cast grain instead, the paint left as it is.
effects_note: MuMain has no ItemObjectAttribute or RenderPartObject arm for MODEL_BLACK_DRAGON_*: a plain painted set.
cutout_from: Declared, not detected: lower_bd.OZT's alpha is real (decode_texture: 33% cut away), the skirt's outline.
cutout_alpha_from: The sheet's own alpha, not its brightness: the paint is dark, and keyed off brightness it would cut the plate away (Divine's trap, ArmorMale20).
